public_search_observation.interpretation: Public search did not expose enough Facebook profile fields to mark the profile aligned. This is not evidence that the profile is absent; it means direct public field verification remains required.

required_alignment: Use the same canonical business name consistently.
Link to the canonical website where Facebook permits a website field.
Use only verified public phone/contact values.
Describe both Thailand-to-China and China-to-Thailand service directions if factually current.
Do not add an address, warehouse, license, price, transit guarantee, partner or customer-volume claim unless independently verified.
pass_rule: PASS_REAL only after the publicly visible Facebook fields are directly observed and compared with the Operational Facts Registry.
next_action: Build evidence-candidate registry and strengthen answerability on existing core service pages while Facebook direct verification remains pending.
